reserveReview.rationale: The August 31, 2026 independent accountant AUP (Johannes Juara & Rekan / Hari Manurung CPA), dated September 29, reconciles Rp74,085,663,766 of bank collateral to total circulating Rupiah Token at 1:1 and states that procedures inspected bank statements and time-deposit certificates for each collateral account. This new reporting period supersedes the July 2026 basis without changing the disclosed reserve category. Bank identities, account balances, the time-deposit share, maturity terms, and legal custody safeguards remain undisclosed; the engagement expressly provides no audit opinion or other assurance.
